description.p: Lumino is a fast, native desktop IDE for databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server, Oracle, ClickHouse, CockroachDB, TiDB, Firebird, Cassandra/ScyllaDB and Trino. SQL console with completion, streaming result grids, table editing, DDL, SSH tunnels, TLS and an AI assistant with read-only tools.
